mock_data.title: Bad News
mock_data.passage:
Thank you all for giving up your Saturday morning to come into the office. My partner, Robert Brown, and I have asked you here today to give you some rather bad news, I am afraid. We were anxious that you should hear this news directly from us, rather than hear it on the grapevine. Inevitably, it is only a matter of time before it is all over town.

To come straight to the point, I have to tell you that the firm of Blair and Brown Ltd has gone into receivership. I am sure many of you are aware of how badly small firms like ourselves have been hit by the recession. We have struggled on as long as we could, but we were forced to accept that the writing was on the wall. Despite various budgetary strategies, which included cutting our operating costs to the minimum and having to let several valuable members of staff go, we just do not have enough money to pay our creditors and carry on trading.

Some of you may well be wondering why another firm did not buy us. Originally, we hoped that this would be the solution to our problems, but this was not to be. We explored every avenue, but to no avail. At other times, the firm would have been an attractive prospect to prospective buyers, but not now. Because of the recession, many small to medium firms have their backs to the wall and are looking for white knights. It is very much a buyer's market, but there are too few buyers around. Larger companies appear to be conserving their capital and are unwilling to become involved in takeovers or mergers.

It goes without saying that we are very sad to have had to come to such a decision and to be leaving you all in such an uncertain position. However, we are simply bowing to the inevitable. What happens from now on will be the responsibility of the official receiver. Someone will be appointed to examine the financial position closely and further efforts will be made to find a buyer. We do hope that these efforts are successful and that your jobs will be safe.

Thank you all for the loyal service which you have given us over the years. We wish you all the best for the future.

Hello everyone. Thank you for coming to the office on a Saturday morning. My partner, Robert Brown, and I have asked you here because we have some bad news. We wanted you to hear it from us first, before you hear it from someone else. Soon, everyone will know.

I will be direct. Our company, Blair and Brown Ltd, has gone into receivership. I am sure you know that small companies like ours have had a hard time because of the recession. We tried to keep going as long as we could. But we had to accept that we could not continue. We tried many things to save money, including cutting costs and letting some good workers go. But we still do not have enough money to pay our debts and keep the business running.

You may be asking why another company did not buy us. At first, we hoped this would solve our problems. But it did not happen. We tried everything we could. In the past, our company would have been interesting to buyers, but not now. Because of the recession, many small and medium companies are in trouble and need help. It is a good time for buyers, but there are not many buyers around. Big companies are keeping their money and do not want to take over other companies or merge with them.

Of course, we are very sad about this decision. We are sorry to leave you in this uncertain situation. But we have to accept what is happening. An official receiver will now be in charge. They will look closely at our finances and try to find a buyer. We hope they are successful, and that you will keep your jobs.

Thank you for your loyalty and hard work over the years. We wish you all the best for the future. We hope everything works out for you.

mock_data.passageC1:
Good morning, everyone, and thank you for sacrificing your Saturday to be here. My partner, Robert Brown, and I have convened this meeting to deliver some rather unwelcome news, I'm afraid. We felt it imperative that you hear this directly from us, rather than through the inevitable rumour mill. It is, alas, only a matter of time before this information becomes public knowledge.

To cut to the chase, Blair and Brown Ltd has been placed into receivership. I'm sure many of you are acutely aware of the deleterious impact the ongoing recession has had on small businesses such as ours. We persevered for as long as conceivably possible, but ultimately, we were compelled to acknowledge that the writing was on the wall. Despite implementing various austerity measures, including minimising operational expenditure and, regrettably, having to part ways with several valued members of staff, we simply lack the requisite capital to meet our obligations to creditors and continue trading.

Some of you may understandably be questioning why a potential acquisition by another firm did not materialise. Initially, we were sanguine that this would offer a viable solution to our financial woes, but this proved to be a false dawn. We exhausted every avenue in pursuit of a takeover, but to no avail. Under more favourable economic conditions, the firm would undoubtedly have presented an attractive proposition to prospective purchasers, but circumstances dictate otherwise. The prevailing recession has placed numerous small to medium-sized enterprises in a precarious position, desperately seeking external investment. It is unequivocally a buyer's market, yet there is a paucity of willing buyers. Larger corporations appear to be hoarding capital and exhibiting a marked reluctance to engage in acquisitions or mergers.

It goes without saying that we are profoundly saddened to have been compelled to reach this juncture and to be leaving you all in such a state of uncertainty. However, we are merely yielding to the inevitable. The responsibility for the company's future now rests with the official receiver. An appointee will be tasked with conducting a thorough examination of the financial standing and pursuing further efforts to identify a purchaser. We sincerely hope that these endeavours prove fruitful and that your positions will be safeguarded. We are cautiously optimistic that this can be achieved.

Finally, thank you all for the unwavering loyalty and dedication you have demonstrated over the years. We extend our sincere best wishes for your future endeavours and hope you will land on your feet. We are grateful for your unwavering commitment.

mock_data.translation:
Shanba kuni ertalab ofisga kelganingiz uchun barchangizga rahmat. Mening sherigim Robert Braun va men sizlarni bugun bu yerga yomon yangilik berish uchun chaqirdik, afsuski. Biz bu yangiliklarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bizdan eshitishingizni xohladik, mish-mishlar orqali emas. Muqarrar ravishda, bu shahar bo'ylab tarqalishidan oldin faqat vaqt masalasi.

To'g'ridan-to'g'ri aytadigan bo'lsak, men sizlarga Bleyr va Braun Ltd firmasi qabul qiluvchilik ostiga o'tganini aytishim kerak. Ishonchim komilki, ko'pchilingiz bizga o'xshash kichik firmalar turg'unlikdan qanchalik qattiq zarba olganidan xabardorsiz. Biz imkon qadar davom ettirdik, ammo devorga yozuv borligi tan olishga majbur bo'ldik. Turli xil byudjet strategiyalariga qaramay, shu jumladan operatsion xarajatlarimizni minimumga qisqartirish va bir nechta qimmatli xodimlarni ishdan bo'shatishni o'z ichiga olgan holda, bizda kreditorlarimizga to'lash va savdoni davom ettirish uchun yetarli pul yo'q.

Ba'zilaringiz nega boshqa firma bizni sotib olmadi deb hayron bo'lishingiz mumkin. Dastlab, biz bu bizning muammolarimizga yechim bo'ladi deb umid qilgan edik, ammo bu shunday bo'lmadi. Biz barcha imkoniyatlarni o'rganib chiqdik, ammo foydasiz. Boshqa paytlarda firma bo'lajak xaridorlar uchun jozibali istiqbol bo'lar edi, ammo hozir emas. Turg'unlik tufayli ko'plab kichik va o'rta firmalar devorga suyanib turibdi va oq ritsarlarni qidirishmoqda. Bu juda ham xaridor bozori, ammo atrofda juda kam xaridorlar bor. Yirik kompaniyalar o'z kapitallarini saqlab qolayotganga o'xshaydi va qo'shib olishlar yoki birlashishlar bilan shug'ullanishni xohlamaydilar.

Aytish o'z-o'zidan tushunarli, biz bunday qaror qabul qilish va sizlarni bunday noaniq holatda qoldirishdan juda qayg'uramiz. Biroq, biz shunchaki muqarrarlikka ta'zim qilyapmiz. Bundan keyin nima bo'lishi rasmiy qabul qiluvchining mas'uliyatida bo'ladi. Kimdir moliyaviy vaziyatni yaqindan tekshirish uchun tayinlanadi va xaridor topish uchun keyingi harakatlar qilinadi. Biz bu sa'y-harakatlar muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishiga va sizning ishingiz xavfsiz bo'lishiga umid qilamiz.

Yillar davomida bizga bergan sodiq xizmatingiz uchun barchangizga rahmat. Kelajakda sizlarga eng yaxshisini tilaymiz.

mock_data.translationB1:
Assalomu alaykum, hurmatli hamkasblar. Shanba kuni ertalab ofisga kelganingiz uchun rahmat. Mening sherigim Robert Braun va men sizlarni bu yerga yomon xabarni yetkazish uchun chaqirdik. Buni boshqalardan eshitishingizdan oldin, o'zimizdan eshitishingizni istadik. Tez orada hamma bilib oladi.

To'g'ridan-to'g'ri aytaman. Bizning kompaniyamiz, "Blair and Brown Ltd", bankrotlikka uchradi. Ishonchim komilki, biz kabi kichik kompaniyalar iqtisodiy inqiroz tufayli qiyin ahvolda ekanligini bilasiz. Iloji boricha davom etishga harakat qildik. Ammo davom eta olmasligimizni tan olishga majbur bo'ldik. Pulni tejash uchun ko'p narsalarni qildik, jumladan xarajatlarni qisqartirdik va ba'zi yaxshi ishchilarni ishdan bo'shatdik. Ammo bizda hali ham qarzlarni to'lash va biznesni yuritish uchun yetarli pul yo'q.

Nega boshqa kompaniya bizni sotib olmadi, deb so'rashingiz mumkin. Dastlab, bu muammolarimizni hal qiladi deb umid qilgan edik. Ammo bu sodir bo'lmadi. Qo'limizdan kelganicha harakat qildik. Ilgari kompaniyamiz xaridorlar uchun qiziqarli bo'lar edi, ammo hozir emas. Iqtisodiy inqiroz tufayli ko'plab kichik va o'rta kompaniyalar muammoga duch kelishdi va yordamga muhtoj. Bu xaridorlar uchun yaxshi vaqt, lekin xaridorlar unchalik ko'p emas. Katta kompaniyalar pullarini saqlab qolishmoqda va boshqa kompaniyalarni egallab olishni yoki ular bilan qo'shilishni xohlashmaydi.

Albatta, biz bu qarordan juda xafamiz. Sizni bunday noaniq vaziyatda qoldirayotganimiz uchun afsusdamiz. Ammo sodir bo'layotgan voqeani qabul qilishimiz kerak. Hozir rasmiy ishonchli vakil mas'ul bo'ladi. Ular bizning moliyamizni diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqadilar va xaridor topishga harakat qiladilar. Umid qilamizki, ular muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishadi va siz o'z ishingizni saqlab qolasiz.

Yillar davomidagi sadoqatingiz va mehnatingiz uchun rahmat. Sizga kelajakda eng yaxshi tilaklarimizni bildiramiz. Umid qilamizki, hammasi siz uchun yaxshi bo'ladi.
mock_data.translationB2:
Assalomu alaykum, hammaga xayrli kun va shanba kuni kelganingiz uchun rahmat. Hamkasbim Robert Braun va men sizlarni bu uchrashuvga chaqirdik, chunki sizlar bilan biroz yoqimsiz xabarni bo'lishmoqchimiz. Biz bu haqda avvalo sizlardan eshitishingizni istadik, mish-mishlar orqali emas. Tez orada bu gap butun shaharga tarqalishi muqarrar.

Ochiqchasiga aytsak, "Blair va Braun Ltd" hozirda vaqtincha boshqaruvga o'tdi. Ishonchim komilki, ko'pchiligingiz biz kabi kichik bizneslar ushbu inqiroz davrida qanday qiyinchiliklarga duch kelayotganidan xabardorsiz. Biz imkon qadar sabr-toqat qildik, lekin vaziyat bardosh berib bo'lmaydigan darajaga yetganini tan olishga majbur bo'ldik. Ish xarajatlarimizni minimal darajaga tushirish va, afsuski, qadrli xodimlarimizning bir qismini ishdan bo'shatish kabi turli xarajatlarni qisqartirish choralarini ko'rganimizga qaramay, bizda qarzlarimizni to'lash va savdoni davom ettirish uchun yetarli mablag' yo'q.

Ba'zilaringiz nima uchun boshqa kompaniya bizni sotib olmadi deb o'ylashingiz mumkin. Dastlab, biz bu yechim bo'ladi deb umid qilgan edik, lekin unday bo'lmadi. Biz barcha imkoniyatlarni o'rganib chiqdik, ammo foydasi bo'lmadi. Yaxshiroq zamonlarda bizning firmamiz potentsial xaridorlar uchun juda jozibali taklif bo'lishi mumkin edi, lekin hozirgi sharoitda emas. Inqiroz tufayli ko'plab kichik va o'rta bizneslar o'z jonini saqlab qolishga harakat qilmoqda va investorlar qidirmoqda. Bu juda xaridorlar bozori, lekin tavakkal qilishga tayyor xaridorlar juda kam. Katta kompaniyalar o'z resurslarini tejashga harakat qilmoqda va qo'shib olish yoki birlashishda ishtirok etishni istamaydi.

Aytishga hojat yo'q, biz bu nuqtaga yetganimizdan va sizlarni bunday noaniq vaziyatda qoldirayotganimizdan juda xafamiz. Biroq, biz o'zgartira olmaydigan narsani shunchaki qabul qilyapmiz. Keyingi nima bo'lishiga endi rasmiy boshqaruvchi javobgar bo'ladi. Moliyaviy vaziyatni diqqat bilan o'rganish uchun kimdir tayinlanadi va xaridor topish uchun keyingi urinishlar qilinadi. Biz bu harakatlar muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishiga va sizning ishlaringiz xavfsiz bo'lishiga chin dildan umid qilamiz.

Ko'p yillar davomida ko'rsatgan sadoqatingiz va xizmatlaringiz uchun barchangizga rahmat. Kelajakda barchangizga eng yaxshi tilaklarimizni bildiramiz.
mock_data.translationC1:
Assalomu alaykum, hurmatli hamkasblar! Shanba kuningizni qurbon qilib shu yerga kelganingiz uchun tashakkur. Sherigim Robert Braun va men, afsuski, sizga bir yoqimsiz xabarni yetkazish uchun ushbu yig'ilishni chaqirdik. Bu xabarni mish-mishlardan emas, balki bevosita bizdan eshitishingiz muhim deb hisobladik. Afsuski, bu ma'lumotning hammaga ma'lum bo'lishi faqat vaqt masalasi.

Gapni qisqa qilib aytganda, "Blair va Braun Ltd" kompaniyasi tashqi boshqaruvga topshirildi. Ishonchim komilki, ko'pchiligingiz davom etayotgan inqiroz biznikiga o'xshash kichik bizneslarga qanday salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatayotganini yaxshi bilasiz. Biz iloji boricha bardosh berdik, ammo oxir-oqibatda vaziyat chatoqligini tan olishga majbur bo'ldik. Operatsion xarajatlarni minimallashtirish va, afsuski, bir nechta qimmatli xodimlar bilan hayrlashishga to'g'ri kelgan turli tejamkorlik choralarini ko'rganimizga qaramay, kreditorlar oldidagi majburiyatlarimizni bajarish va savdoni davom ettirish uchun yetarli kapitalimiz yo'q.

Ba'zilaringiz nega boshqa firma tomonidan potentsial sotib olish amalga oshmaganini so'rashingiz mumkin. Dastlab, bu moliyaviy muammolarimizga yechim bo'ladi deb o'ylagan edik, ammo bu umidbaxsh bo'lib chiqdi, xolos. Biz sotib olish bo'yicha barcha imkoniyatlarni ishga soldik, ammo foydasi bo'lmadi. Iqtisodiy sharoit yaxshiroq bo'lganida, firma shubhasiz potentsial xaridorlar uchun jozibali taklif bo'lar edi, ammo vaziyat boshqacha bo'lishini talab qilmoqda. Hozirgi inqiroz ko'plab kichik va o'rta korxonalarni tashqi investitsiyalarni izlashga majbur qilib, nozik ahvolga solib qo'ydi. Bu, shubhasiz, xaridor bozori, ammo xaridorlar yetishmaydi. Yirik korporatsiyalar kapitallarini yashirib, sotib olish yoki qo'shilishdan qat'iy bosh tortayotganga o'xshaydi.

Shuni ta'kidlash joizki, biz ushbu nuqtaga yetib kelganimizdan va sizlarning barchangizni bunday noaniq ahvolda qoldirayotganimizdan juda afsusdamiz. Biroq, biz shunchaki muqarrarlikka taslim bo'lyapmiz. Kompaniyaning kelajagi uchun javobgarlik endi rasmiy boshqaruvchiga yuklatiladi. Tayinlangan shaxsga moliyaviy ahvolni batafsil o'rganish va xaridorni aniqlash bo'yicha keyingi harakatlarni davom ettirish vazifasi yuklatiladi. Ushbu harakatlar muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishiga va lavozimlaringiz himoyalanishiga chin dildan umid qilamiz. Biz bunga erishish mumkinligiga ehtiyotkorlik bilan umid qilamiz.

Va nihoyat, yillar davomida namoyish etgan sadoqatingiz va fidoyiligingiz uchun barchangizga rahmat. Kelgusi faoliyatingizda sizlarga chin dildan omad tilaymiz va o'zingizga mos ish topasiz degan umiddamiz. Sizning qat'iy sadoqatingiz uchun minnatdormiz.
